Public ESPN standings captured on 2026-09-13 through the bot's bounded JSON fetcher.
Each file includes its exact source URL and the provider's season dates. Only team
identity, group names, and standings statistics are retained. Entry order, field
capitalization, duplicate NHL overtime aliases, and numeric values are unchanged.
These are fixed parser fixtures, not a current-results cache. NBA/NHL tests use a
clock within the represented season to test parsing, and separate offseason tests
must refuse the same data. No test fetches these URLs.
